metaDescription: Improved Smooth Cayene bell pepper is an open pollinated bell pepper variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
keywords: Improved Smooth Cayene bell pepper variety
excerpt: Improved Smooth Cayene bell pepper is an open pollinated bell pepper variety, also sold or known as Smooth Cayene or Improved Smooth Cayenne sweet pepper. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Harbest Agribusiness (Seeds of Hope).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Improved Smooth Cayene bell pepper is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Smooth Cayene or Improved Smooth Cayenne sweet pepper, this is the same bell pepper. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [bell pepper variety finder](/crop-varieties/bell-pepper), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: 90 to 95 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit bell pepper fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 90 to 95 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Conical sweet pepper with thick flesh, green turning red, that ships well.
Can be planted in the wet and the dry season.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual bell pepper on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Improved Smooth Cayene bell pepper

Bell pepper does best in cool places such as Benguet and Bukidnon. In the lowlands, pick a heat tolerant hybrid and grow it in the dry season under some shade. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: Is Smooth Cayene the same as Improved Smooth Cayene?
items.a: Yes. Smooth Cayene is another name for Improved Smooth Cayene. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Improved Smooth Cayene?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
